body:
This issue is really old, but has good SEO. I'm adding on here a possible new case where rootPath will behave wrongly (in v4):

1. have a hierarchical refinement on the page which is not the root refinement
2. add a hierarchical menu with a rootPath to the page
3. notice it does not take the rootPath in account, and keeps the old refinement

This happens because we might not be calling `.make` on `SearchParameters` (only place where rootPath "exists" / is put back where something else is refined).

This bug is mostly hypothetical, and should be confirmed if someone has it
